The previous rigorous 0.753659844 certificate and the source finite-prefix 0.778307 figure leave a 0.02465 gap; this certifies 0.770667314, closing about 69% of that specific gap and giving the first located rigorous >77% threshold. Finite computational complexity is matched by an exact rational, transparent certificate and infinite-density theorem; no claim is made that the numerical cutoff is optimal.
